propositions: Extend autodeploy.sh with an mcp target implementing ADR 0079 blue-green pointer-swap to track origin/main without killing in-flight certified operations (eliminates bug 7b4a).
Implement memory pre-check against MemAvailable < MCP_MEM_MIN_MB (default 1024 MB) before container start; abort with AUTODEPLOY_MCP_MEM_ABORT backoff if threshold breached.
Perform atomic nginx upstream swap by backing up, writing to dotfile temp, atomically moving to /etc/nginx/mcp-upstream.conf, and reloading; restore backup and rollback on failure.

Retire old MCP container gracefully via docker stop --time 1260 (SIGTERM self-drain) in background, never docker rm -f; emit AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP if managed container count exceeds MCP_RELEASES_CAP (3).
Allocate new container to free blue-green host port (MCP_PORT_A=8092 or MCP_PORT_B=8093); do not start 3rd colliding container if both ports bound.
Add CloudWatch alerting markers AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP and AUTODEPLOY_MCP_MEM_ABORT via observability.sh publish_autodeploy_marker_delta, routing to SNS with no direct SNS publish.
